headline: Nevish Line Erupts Anew as Heavy Fighting Grips the Fronts
war_summary: The Nevish Line, silent at our last accounting, has burst into flame again: twenty-two actions mark its day's ledger, Princefal and Blackcoat Way the most contested grounds, and the latest report logged as this edition goes to press. Callahan's Passage shows no let-up either; the Wardens' hold on nine of its ten posts is unshaken, but the fighting about The Latch and Crumbling Post has turned newly savage, with better than four thousand casualties fallen to each side in the final two hours alone. The Weathered Expanse keeps its grim primacy, its cumulative toll now standing at 219,216 against 253,203, while Frostmarch, Huntsfort and Wightwalk remain the busiest works. Stonecradle rests at two Warden posts to seven Colonial and Stlican Shelf at three to six, both still changing hands as late as half past eight, and Linn Mercy has stirred once more around Lathair. By contrast, Fisherman's Row, Viper Pit and Mooring County lie quiet, their last base actions logged the previous afternoon. It is day 449 of the war; the casualty ledgers of the past two hours record sharp acceleration on every active front, thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
